wire.name: wire
wire.look: A length of wire. Probably live. Possibly sentient. Definitely not insured.

reactor.name: reactor
reactor.look: A warp-core reactor, cooled to merely 'unwise to lick'. It hums in a tone that suggests it has plans for you.

ladder.name: ladder
ladder.look: A lightweight ladder, the sort that has caught people out, and will catch you out too, if you let it.

buckazoids.name: buckazoids
buckazoids.look: 350 buckazoids. The galaxy's currency, and the only sort of friend a janitor can afford.

manual.name: pod manual
manual.look: The Escape Pod Owner's Manual, 3rd edition, 'Now With Fewer Warnings'. Section 4, 'Starting a Ship': engines first. Radar before takeoff, always (see Section 9, 'Walls'). Front shields before you fire at anything, ever. The manufacturer accepts no liability for the contents of Section 9.
